desc:
[This game has entered ALPHA! Expect changes and lots of bugs!]

Welcome to your eternal prison.

Enter its realm and encounter all sorts of familiar faces; whether they're friends, foes, or both, you're bound to run into them at some point.

Survivor: Protect your teammates, complete objectives, and survive until the timer hits 0.

Killer: Kill them all, leave no one standing. Do whatever it takes.

Once you decide to enter, there's no going back. This is your home now. Eternal by it forever.a
